relationship: A journey's motion is encoded by distance-time gradient and speed-time area, with the trolley providing the same event in physical and graphical forms.

learnerLoop.action: Edit a journey, run or scrub the trolley, and complete the requested calculation.
learnerLoop.modelChange: Journey timings, graph segments and the trolley position update together.
learnerLoop.evidence: The linked animation, graphs, limits and checked working show rate or accumulated distance.
learnerLoop.nextDecision: Revise a segment or use gradient or area to meet the journey constraint.

invariants: Distance-time gradient represents speed for each segment.
safeAdaptations: Vary solvable journey constraints and graph values.
Adjust calculation support while keeping the trolley and graph synchronised.
nonGoals: Interpreting graph shape without relating it to the journey it represents.
